sentences.text: For a Tier 3 UCB, the in-force rule for loans to MSEs says no pre-payment charges apply only when the sanctioned amount/limit is up to ₹50 lakh, and the case facts say the amount is ₹80 lakh, so that no-charge rule does not cover this loan amount.
For cases other than those covered by that no-charge rule, pre-payment charges may be as per the UCB’s approved policy, and for term loans any levied charge must be based on the amount being prepaid.

The directions also require the applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges to be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and they say charges not disclosed as specified there shall not be charged.

I cannot determine from the provided evidence whether the 2% charge is a violation, because the sanction date and the actual sanction-letter wording for the 2% charge are not provided in the evidence set searched.

missing.searched: Reviewed the sanction-letter evidence and the in-force UCB pre-payment-charge directions for a date-based applicability check.
Reviewed the sanction-letter evidence for the disclosed pre-payment charge wording and percentage.
